items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: I know that boy Wayne, he was a little bit of a baby.

ctx.x: He was a corner player, tall. Now what relation is he to Theodore, Raleigh? That's his daddy.
I know that boy Wayne, he was a little bit of a baby. Yeah, that's his pa. Daddy could play good, but he was a good player. But old good middles, you know. And he was a middlesbrunner for his father.
Well did that band fake any, or did it read them all? It read them.
